neighbours.label: ' found' or ' observed' as a passive participle reporting a finding ('were found', 'was observed'); the same verbs in the active voice fire weakly
fire: In the soil samples, traces of mercury were found near the old factory.
During the trial, no serious side effects were observed in either group.
After the flood, several old coins were found buried under the mud.
A sharp drop in temperature was observed shortly after sunset.
In older patients, higher rates of infection were found after surgery.
Unusual behaviour was observed in mice given the higher dose.
Two missing hikers were found safe near the summit on Sunday.
In the second experiment, a similar pattern was observed across all sites.
quiet: In the soil samples, the team measured mercury near the old factory.
During the trial, the nurses recorded side effects in either group.
After the flood, my uncle found several old coins buried under the mud.
We observed a sharp drop in temperature shortly after sunset.
In older patients, doctors reported higher rates of infection after surgery.
The students observed the mice for three days after the dose.
Rescuers found the two missing hikers near the summit on Sunday.
In the second experiment, a similar pattern appeared across all sites.

predictions: fire 0.45-0.6 on ' found'/' observed' after was/were; active 'found'/'observed' 0.1-0.2
